relationships.subject: pregnenolone sulfate
relationships.evidence_quote: PS (100 µM) significantly increased the amplitudes of TTX-R INaT and INaP

relationships.subject: dehydroepiandrosterone
relationships.evidence_quote: DHEA (100 µM) significantly decreased the amplitudes of TTX-R INaT and INaP

relationships.subject: pregnenolone sulfate
relationships.evidence_quote: PS also significantly increased the amplitude of the NaV1.9-mediated current in a concentration-dependent manner

relationships.subject: pregnenolone sulfate
relationships.evidence_quote: PS decreased the rheobase current-the minimum current required to generate action potentials-and increased the number of action potentials elicited by depolarizing current stimuli.

key_findings: PS potentiates Nav1.8-mediated TTX-R persistent current, shifts inactivation depolarized, delays inactivation onset and reduces use-dependent inhibition in dural afferent neurons.
PS lowers rheobase and increases firing despite hyperpolarizing neurons via leak K+ conductance; DHEA has opposite inhibitory effect on TTX-R current.
